name: Chuck roast
definition: beef roasting or braising joint from the chuck (shoulder).

name: Flat iron steak
definition: beef steak cut from the top blade muscle of the chuck.

name: Ribeye steak
definition: beef steak cut from the rib section, bone-in or boneless.

name: Striploin steak
definition: beef steak cut from the short loin (strip loin).
notes: sold as New York strip / Kansas City strip; also bison striploin

name: Tenderloin
definition: the beef tenderloin (fillet), whole or cut into steaks.

name: T-bone / porterhouse steak
definition: bone-in beef steak from the short loin holding both striploin and tenderloin across a T-shaped bone.

name: Top sirloin steak
definition: beef steak cut from the top sirloin (rump side of the loin).
notes: sold as top sirloin steak

name: Rump cap (picanha)
definition: the beef rump cap muscle with its fat cap, whole or sliced.
notes: sold as picanha / rump cap, whole or steaks

name: Skirt steak
definition: beef steak cut from the diaphragm muscles (outer or inner skirt).

name: Short rib
definition: beef rib section cut short across or along the bones.

name: Brisket
definition: beef joint from the breast, whole or as point or flat.

name: Shin / shank
definition: beef cut from the lower leg, on or off the bone.
notes: sold as shank and sliced shanks

name: Beef primal or side
definition: beef sold as a primal (chuck, rib, loin, round, flank, plate, brisket, shank), side or carcass.
notes: wholesale primals by IMPS number (ribeye roll, chuck roll); quarter sold at Dakota Butcher

name: Ground beef
definition: raw minced beef sold loose or packed.

name: Shaped raw mince, beef (burgers, meatballs)
definition: raw minced beef shaped into burgers, meatballs or similar, plain or only seasoned.
notes: burger patties and raw beef meatballs sold plain

name: Beef tongue
definition: the tongue of cattle, sold raw.

name: Sweetbreads
definition: the thymus or pancreas glands of a calf, sold raw (the animal is not stated on the fetched page; veal assumed).
notes: page names the animal: Veal Sweetbreads

name: Pork jowl
definition: the cheek and jowl of a pig, sold raw.

name: Pork collar
definition: pork cut from the neck and upper shoulder (collar, Boston butt).
notes: sold as collar, coppa steaks and Boston butt

name: Pork loin chop
definition: pork chop cut across the loin, bone-in or boneless.

name: Pork tenderloin
definition: the pork tenderloin (fillet), whole or in medallions.

name: Pork ribs
definition: pork rib sections (spare ribs, baby back ribs), sold raw.
notes: St Louis, spare and baby back ribs sold raw

name: Pork belly
definition: raw, uncured pork belly, skin-on or skinless.

name: Pork hock
definition: the lower leg joint of a pig above the trotter, sold raw.

name: Pork trotter
definition: the foot of a pig, sold raw.
notes: trotter shown as feet/trotter cuts; partial in both pages

name: Suckling pig
definition: a whole milk-fed young pig, sold whole.

name: Ground pork
definition: raw minced pork sold loose or packed.

name: Shaped raw mince, pork (burgers, meatballs)
definition: raw minced pork shaped into burgers, meatballs or similar, plain or only seasoned.
notes: plain fresh pork burgers sold

name: Lamb rack
definition: the rib section of a lamb with its chops joined, sold raw.

name: Lamb leg
definition: the hind leg of a lamb, whole or part, on or off the bone.

name: Lamb, whole or jointed
definition: lamb or mutton sold whole or as any cut not yet a kind (the cut is the attribute `cut`).
notes: lamb, hogget and mutton sold whole, half and jointed

name: Suckling lamb
definition: a whole milk-fed young lamb, sold whole.
notes: cordero lechal / lechazo, 100% milk-fed, sold raw and frozen

name: Goat, whole or jointed
definition: goat meat sold whole or as any cut (the cut is the attribute `cut`).

name: Whole chicken
definition: a whole dressed chicken carcass, including poussin and capon.
notes: whole chicken, poussin and capon each sold

name: Chicken breast
definition: the breast meat of a chicken, on or off the bone, skin-on or skinless.

name: Chicken leg
definition: the leg of a chicken (thigh and drumstick together or apart).

name: Turkey, whole or jointed
definition: turkey sold whole or as any cut (the cut is the attribute `cut`).

name: Duck breast
definition: the breast of a duck, skin-on, sold raw.

name: Whole duck
definition: a whole dressed duck carcass.

name: Fatty liver (foie gras)
definition: the enlarged liver of a duck or goose, sold raw.
notes: raw Grade A duck foie gras whole lobes and slices

name: Pheasant, whole or jointed
definition: pheasant sold whole or as any cut (the cut is the attribute `cut`).
notes: pheasant sold oven-ready whole

name: Partridge, whole or jointed
definition: partridge sold whole or as any cut (the cut is the attribute `cut`).
notes: partridge sold oven-ready whole, brace

name: Venison saddle
definition: the saddle (loin section) of a deer, on or off the bone.
notes: saddle of venison, bone-in or boneless

name: Venison medallions
definition: round slices cut from the venison loin.
notes: venison medallions listed as a product

name: Venison, whole or jointed
definition: venison sold whole or as any cut not yet a kind (the cut is the attribute `cut`).

name: Rabbit, whole or jointed
definition: rabbit sold whole or as any cut (the cut is the attribute `cut`).

name: Hare, whole or jointed
definition: hare sold whole or as any cut (the cut is the attribute `cut`).
notes: whole wild hare skinned, sold frozen only

name: Wild boar, whole or jointed
definition: wild boar sold whole or as any cut (the cut is the attribute `cut`; wild or farmed is an attribute).

name: Horse meat, whole or jointed
definition: horse meat sold whole or as any cut, including raw slices for eating raw (the cut is the attribute `cut`).
notes: horse meat steaks, rib-eye, tenderloin; raw basashi in Japan

name: Bison, whole or jointed
definition: bison sold whole or as any cut (the cut is the attribute `cut`).
notes: bison ribeye, striploin, top sirloin, chuck flap

name: Frogs' legs
definition: the hind legs of edible frogs, sold raw or frozen.
notes: frogs legs sold by count per lb; state raw/frozen on Citarella

name: Turtle meat
definition: the meat of turtles sold to eat.
notes: frozen boneless snapping turtle meat

name: Edible insects
definition: crickets, mealworms and other insects sold to eat, fresh, frozen, dried or roasted (attribute `storage_state`; K-47).
notes: roasted crickets and mealworms; no fresh or frozen shown

name: Mixed fresh meats
definition: a pack of raw meats of several J1.1 kinds, none of which makes up half or more of its weight.
notes: meat bundles and diced mixed game packs of several kinds
